comparison.objective: Pour acetone to a target volume while keeping the reagent label facing upward.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually reorient, grasp, tip, meter, and replace an open bottle.
comparison.success_condition: Reach the 50 ml mark without label-down flow or more than 2 ml spill; those hazards permanently fail. No spec version is present.
comparison.reason: This is liquid-handling orientation and spill control, not mechanical tuning, tool insertion, or locking.
